root_cause: The convergence player checksum is the checksum of the full PlayerStateSnapshot.
PlayerStateSnapshot checksum covers authority/revision/server_tick plus all player records including position, velocity, last_input_sequence and state_revision.
Therefore requiring current player checksum to remain equal to the PREPARE checksum after release is not a valid invariant for a live 60Hz authoritative simulation.
R6 correctly removed peer deadlock and made release monotonic, but its post-release integrity guard still treated legitimate forward snapshot progression as corruption.

rejected: freeze/quiesce authoritative player simulation solely to satisfy a test barrier
bounded retry on every live snapshot advance
selected: Treat exact PlayerStateSnapshot checksum observed by both clients as a pinned observed-state identity for the convergence generation.
Pin revision, server_tick, authority_owner_id and authority_epoch together with that checksum in the generation PREPARE.
Before release, each client must still have the exact pinned snapshot identity current; this preserves the exact-point convergence proof.
After release consumption, current PlayerStateSnapshot may advance, but revision/server_tick must be monotonic and authority owner/epoch must remain unchanged.
Item Graph checksum remains exact-stable through convergence because the scenario performs no post-prepare Item Graph mutation.
Coordinator COMPLETE remains gated on both durable release acknowledgements for the same pinned generation.

authorized_changes: Add a compact player observation identity to M5 reports: checksum, revision, server_tick, authority_owner_id, authority_epoch.
Parent PREPARE must pin that exact observation identity when both clients report the same player checksum.
Client PREPARE acknowledgement must require the parent-pinned observation identity to equal its exact current PlayerStateSnapshot identity.
After release consumption, validate monotonic revision/server_tick and stable authority identity instead of requiring the full current player checksum to remain unchanged.
Keep current Item Graph checksum equal to the prepared Item Graph checksum until coordinator COMPLETE.
Add regression cases for legal forward snapshot advancement, illegal revision/tick regression, illegal authority change and illegal Item Graph drift.
non_goals: Do not stop or freeze server player simulation.
Do not add retry loops or generation retries solely for normal movement progression.
Do not weaken the pre-release exact snapshot match.
Do not remove exact Item Graph convergence.
Do not change player/network/runtime semantics outside the M5 acceptance barrier.
acceptance_r7: M5 contract test PASS with observed-state identity guards.
Pure convergence regression PASS covering forward player snapshot advancement after release.
Windows exact-Godot M5 stability 10/10 with no hidden reruns.
No WAIT_CONVERGENCE_COORDINATOR timeout and no CURRENT_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE_ADVANCED_AFTER_RELEASE for monotonic forward revision/tick movement.
Authority change, revision/tick regression or Item Graph drift after release must fail explicitly.
Only after 10/10 may one canonical full world regression first attempt be run.
